hero.subtitle: Traffio’s AI replies on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and your website chat, books the appointment into your schedule and calls your team when a person is needed. Scheduling, reminders, records and payments on the same platform.

features.title: What you get on the platform
features.subtitle: Scheduling, patient communication, records and payments: what your team uses every day, in one platform.

agenda.title: Organized schedule and 24/7 online booking
agenda.description: See every professional’s and location’s schedule, and let patients book on their own through the portal or your website.
agenda.item1: Schedule for all professionals and locations
agenda.item2: Online booking through the patient portal
agenda.item3: Booking button to add to your website
agenda.item4: Check-in by phone and a waiting room showing queue position
agenda.item5: Waitlist that notifies patients when a slot opens

ai.title: An AI that answers, resolves questions and books appointments
ai.description: The AI replies to every patient right away, based on the information you register about your clinic, and hands off to your team when the matter needs a person.
ai.item1: Replies 24/7 on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and website chat
ai.item2: Checks open slots and books the appointment into your schedule
ai.item3: Understands voice notes, photos of documents and PDFs from patients
ai.item4: Replies to comments on your Instagram and Facebook posts
ai.item5: Hands off to your team for clinical questions, complaints or when the patient asks
ai.item6: Doesn’t quote prices by message and follows your clinic’s rules
ai.imageAlt: Patient conversation handled by the AI

whatsapp.title: All of your team’s conversations on one screen
whatsapp.description: Connect the WhatsApp your practice already uses, plus Instagram, Messenger and your website chat. Your team handles everything in one place and reminders go out on their own.
whatsapp.item1: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and website chat on one screen
whatsapp.item2: Automatic reminders 48h, 24h and 2h before the appointment (configurable)
whatsapp.item4: Send photos, videos, voice notes and documents
whatsapp.item5: Saved replies and priority labels on conversations
whatsapp.item6: Copilot: the AI suggests replies for your team

prontuario.title: Electronic records with the full history
prontuario.description: Record progress notes and prescriptions, and keep exams and documents on a timeline for each patient. Works for any healthcare specialty.
prontuario.item3: Exams, photos and documents stored in the record
prontuario.item4: Odontogram by tooth surface and treatment estimates (dentistry)
prontuario.item6: Exam image viewer with zoom and brightness

financeiro.title: Organized charges and payments
financeiro.description: Connect your Stripe account to send card payment links. Record other payments in the cashier, and everything shows up in the financial report.
financeiro.item1: Card payment links through your Stripe account
financeiro.item2: Link generated from the approved proposal, ready to send to the patient
financeiro.item3: Charge marked as paid automatically when payment is confirmed
financeiro.item4: Record cash, card machine, Pix, bank transfer and insurance
financeiro.item5: Treatment proposals sent to the patient
financeiro.item6: Financial report: total, received and outstanding

crm.title: Follow every patient, from first contact to appointment
crm.description: See what stage each prospect is at, know which ad they came from, and bring back patients who haven’t returned in months.
crm.item1: Follow-up pipeline from first contact to appointment
crm.item2: Stages updated automatically by the schedule and conversations
crm.item3: Facebook and Instagram ads connection (Meta Ads)
crm.item4: Source of each patient: which ad they came from
crm.item5: Report on ad spend, contacts and cost per contact
crm.item6: Return messages for patients who haven’t come back in months

portal.title: Patient portal
portal.desc: Patients book appointments and follow their bookings on their phone.

sms.title: SMS and calls
sms.desc: Send SMS and make calls from the platform, paying only for what you use.

reports.title: Reports
reports.desc: Financial and marketing reports to keep track of your clinic.

security.title: Data security
security.desc: Each clinic’s data isolated, role-based user access and encrypted connections.

solutions.title: For practices and clinics in any specialty
solutions.subtitle: What changes between plans is the size of your team and how much of your patient communication you want to automate. Click a profile to see everything included.

pricing.title: Simple, no surprises
pricing.subtitle: Fixed price per clinic. No per-provider fees. Cancel anytime.
pricing.allPlansTrial: All plans include a 14-day free trial · No commitment · Cancel anytime

footer.description: An AI-powered platform for patient communication, scheduling and records for healthcare practices and clinics.

guide.modulesNote: Works for any healthcare professional. Ready-made modules: dentistry (odontogram and treatment estimates) and nutrition (anthropometric assessment and meal plans).
guide.aiPack: AI patient support available in packages, from {{price}}

essencial.title: Practice with up to 2 professionals
essencial.desc: For professionals who work alone or in pairs and want a full, organized schedule without relying on a receptionist all the time.
bullets: Online booking: patients book on their own, 24/7
Automatic WhatsApp reminders to reduce no-shows
essencial.fit: Best for practices with 1 or 2 healthcare professionals at a single location that want an organized schedule, fewer no-shows and digital records. Patient conversations stay on the practice’s WhatsApp; AI patient support can be turned on anytime by buying conversation packages.

clinica.title: Clinic with a team of up to 10 professionals
clinica.desc: For clinics that get many contacts on WhatsApp and social media and want no patient left without an answer.
bullets: One inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger
Patient follow-up pipeline and Meta ads integration
Payment links and all specialty modules
clinica.fit: Best for clinics with a front desk and several professionals, at up to 3 locations, that invest in ads and need to reply fast, follow each patient until they book, and take payments online.

rede.title: Clinics with multiple locations
rede.desc: For groups and networks that need unlimited professionals and locations and more AI conversations.
rede.fit: Best for clinic networks and groups with several locations or large teams that need unlimited professionals and locations, more file storage and a higher volume of AI patient support.

aiConversations.label: AI-handled conversations
aiConversations.desc: Each patient handled by the AI counts as 1 conversation. Need more? Buy extra packages that never expire.

aiChannels.label: AI replies 24/7 on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and website chat
aiChannels.desc: Patients get an answer right away, including nights, weekends and holidays.

aiScheduling.label: AI books appointments on its own
aiScheduling.desc: The AI checks open slots and books the appointment straight into your schedule, with no one on your team stepping in.

aiMedia.label: AI understands voice notes, photos of documents and PDFs
aiMedia.desc: Patients can send a voice note or a photo of a document and the AI understands it. Clinical images always go to your team.

aiComments.label: Automatic replies to Instagram and Facebook comments
aiComments.desc: People who comment on your posts get a reply and an invitation to chat and book.

aiCopilot.label: Copilot: AI suggests replies for your team
aiCopilot.desc: When the front desk is handling a conversation, the AI drafts a reply to speed things up.

aiKnowledge.label: AI trained on your clinic’s information
aiKnowledge.desc: Your clinic’s services, hours, insurance and policies. The AI doesn’t quote prices by message and hands off to your team whatever it can’t answer.

agenda.label: Every professional’s schedule on one screen
agenda.desc: See your team’s and every location’s schedule at once.

onlineBooking.label: Online booking through the patient portal
onlineBooking.desc: Patients pick a time and book on their phone, anytime.

siteWidget.label: Booking button on your website
siteWidget.desc: Put your schedule on your website and turn visits into booked appointments.

checkin.label: Digital check-in and waiting room
checkin.desc: Patients confirm arrival on their phone and the front desk follows the queue in real time.

waitlist.label: Waitlist
waitlist.desc: When a slot is canceled, people on the list are notified to take it.

professionals.label: Healthcare professionals
professionals.desc: How many professionals can have a schedule on the platform.

locations.label: Locations
locations.desc: How many care addresses you can register.

whatsappNumbers.label: WhatsApp numbers
whatsappNumbers.desc: Use the number your practice already has. Each extra number costs R$229/month.

reminders.label: Automatic appointment reminders
reminders.desc: Patients get WhatsApp reminders before the appointment, which reduces no-shows.

confirmationNps.label: Attendance confirmation and satisfaction survey
confirmationNps.desc: Patients confirm or reschedule on WhatsApp and rate the visit afterwards.

inbox.label: Team inbox
inbox.desc: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and website chat on one screen, with several agents at once.

media.label: Send photos, videos, voice notes and documents
media.desc: Your team sends instructions and documents to patients right from the platform.

officialApi.label: Official Meta WhatsApp
officialApi.desc: Connection through the official WhatsApp API, with quick-reply buttons for patients.

smsVoice.label: SMS and calls
smsVoice.desc: Send SMS and make calls from the platform, paying only for what you use with prepaid credits.

records.label: Electronic health records
records.desc: Each patient’s full history: progress notes and visits on a timeline.

exams.label: Patient exams and documents
exams.desc: Keep exams, photos and documents in the record, paper-free.

prescriptions.label: Digital prescriptions
prescriptions.desc: Issue prescriptions straight from the record.

modules.label: Specialty modules
modules.desc: Tools for your field, such as odontogram and treatment estimates (dentistry) or anthropometric assessment and meal plans (nutrition).

storage.label: File storage
storage.desc: Space for patients’ exams, photos and documents.

patients.label: Patient and contact registry
patients.desc: All patients and prospects organized in one place.

followup.label: Patient follow-up pipeline (CRM)
followup.desc: See what stage each prospect is at, from first contact to appointment, and don’t lose anyone along the way.

metaAds.label: Facebook and Instagram ads integration
metaAds.desc: Know which ad each patient came from and receive lead-form contacts automatically.

cashier.label: Payment tracking

paymentLinks.label: Card payment links

emailSupport.label: Email support

imageViewer.desc: Open X-rays and photos (JPG or PNG) in the record, with zoom and brightness adjustment.

proposals.label: Treatment proposals
